title: Kyber release 0.25 don land
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
html:
Kyber 0.25!

Kyber 0.25 don comot.

Dis new release carry IPv6 support enter everywhere, plus new DRM/KMS capture backend for Linux, Windows system tray, and solid improvement wey go make am more reliable and easy to use.

See di main tins wey dey inside.

IPv6 support

Both desktop and web clients don dey support IPv6 now. If you wan connect through IPv6 network or dual-stack setup, e go just work without any extra configuration, and e go steady well well like how you dey expect am for IPv4.

We don dey build dis one for di past one year, and na for dis release we finally merge am.

DRM/KMS screen capture for Linux

Linux don get new DRM/KMS grab backend, wey join di X11 and NvFBC options wey dey before.

DRM/KMS dey capture straight from di display driver level. So e dey useful for setup wey no get normal desktop environment, like headless server or bare-metal streaming rig.

Icon for Windows system tray

Di Windows server now dey show icon for system tray, so you fit quickly see how di server dey without to dey dig inside terminal or task manager.

How Windows dey handle am when person unplug display

Di capture and encoding server for Windows now dey handle am well when person unplug display while streaming session still dey run. Before, if you disconnect monitor as e dey run, e fit crash or hang. We don fix dat one now.

Fix dem for reliability and to make am easy to use

Plenty fix dey wey go improve how reliable di whole stack dey every day:

kyctl: Now, if error happen for control-plane connection, e go show clear clear instead of make e fail quietly. Dis one go make am much easier to find wetin spoil.

kycontroller: We don fix one bug wey make di public port wey dem configure for di server dey cache anyhow, come dey give clients old values wey don expire.

kycontroller: We don fix one deadlock wey fit make di /login endpoint hang forever when mutex contention happen.

kycontroller: Di QUIC transport accept loop don strong pass before, so e fit now handle edge cases for incoming connection well well.

kynput/win32: Now e dey monitor keyboard setting changes as e dey run, so input go still behave correct even if user change keyboard settings for middle of session.

kyclient: We don add HTTP timeout to all di request wey dey comot from both desktop and web client. Dis one go stop dem from hanging when network no too strong.

kyctl now fit generate JWT key straight from di command line. Dis one make am easy to manage certificate and token without any external tool.

Upgrade

Kyber 0.25 don dey available now.

Go di downloads page make you download di latest version, or pull di updated packages through your normal channel.

We dey welcome your feedback and any bug report wey you get.
